notes.title: Release scheduled for November.
notes.notes:
Hello guys!
We are constantly focused on completing the game for an "early build", remembering that initially we will not release everything at once, we plan at least 1 weekly update with basic features until we reach a "stable build".

Thank you so much for everyone's patience!
Sincerely UltimateTeam.
